title: Prime Retirement and Aged Care Property Trust (Prime Trust) - proposed acquisition of 40% interest in Babcock & Brown Communities Group
acquirers: Prime Retirement and Aged Care Property Trust (Prime Trust)

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the context of local markets for the provision of aged care facilities.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition as a number of alternative providers of aged care facilities operate in the local regions where the merging parties' facilities overlap.
